3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: I was preparing to sleep when the private phone in my living quarters rang.
3.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_RelationshipPublic"] == true) == false)

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: I knew that if someone was calling at this hour, something urgent must have happened. The phone rang again.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: The ringing sound felt off for some reason. I knew something was wrong.

15.speaker: Hugo Toras
15.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Summer_Hugo"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] == true) == false)

19.speaker: Hugo Toras
19.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Summer_Hugo"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] == true) == false)

21.speaker: Hugo Toras
21.text: "Please take a seat if you aren't."

27.speaker: Hugo Toras
27.text: "It breaks my heart to inform you that your daughter, our Princess Vina has passed away during her captivity in Pales."

28.speaker: Hugo Toras
28.text: "I am so sorry, Romus. Truly. I can't even imagine--"

29.speaker: Narrator
29.text: I did not hear the rest of it. All I heard was the ringing of my ears. I dropped the phone on the ground.

30.speaker: Narrator
30.text: I started breathing heavily. It felt like my heart was being squeezed with a wrench.

31.speaker: Narrator
31.text: I felt helpless. I wanted to scream. I wanted to--

32.speaker: Narrator
32.text: It was all in vain. Everything. My life. The crown.
32.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Lord"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_RelationshipPublic"] == true) == false)

37.speaker: Narrator
37.text: My vision tunneled. I couldn't breathe anymore. I fell down.

38.speaker: Narrator
38.text: I curled up on the chair.

43.speaker: Narrator
43.text: Bruno rushed to my side and licked my face. I hugged him tight.

47.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
47.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Rescue_Success"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] == true) == false)

56.speaker: Hugo Toras
56.text: "I was handling crown matters near the border when I received the news that Princess Vina and her rescuers had arrived from the front lines."

57.speaker: Narrator
57.text: I heard the faint voice of a woman in the background.

59.speaker: Vina Toras
59.text: "I'm safe. We will soon fly to the palace."

61.speaker: Narrator
61.text: She was laughing and crying at the same time.

63.speaker: Player_Romus
63.text: "I am so glad you are okay."

64.speaker: Player_Romus
64.text: "It is so good to hear your voice."

65.speaker: Narrator
65.text: I could feel my knees go weak. It was really her.

66.speaker: Hugo Toras
66.text: "And I am here with someone who has been longing to speak with you for months."

68.speaker: Player_Romus
68.text: "Are you hurt? Did your captors hurt you?"

69.speaker: Player_Romus
69.text: "I swear it on the name of House Toras. They will pay in blood."

73.speaker: Player_Romus
73.text: "No matter what, you are safe now."

74.speaker: Player_Romus
74.text: "I will make sure that your captors will be punished accordingly."

75.speaker: Vina Toras
75.text: "You don't know how good it is to hear your voice. After all this time in captivity..."

76.speaker: Vina Toras
76.text: "No, I'm fine. They didn't dare lay a finger on the Crown Princess."

77.speaker: Vina Toras
77.text: "War is war, Father. I'm sure Rizia would have done the same or worse if we'd captured Duke Reinhart..."

78.speaker: Vina Toras
78.text: "It's Duke Reinhart you should punish. Everyone else was just following his orders."

80.speaker: Vina Toras
80.text: "I'll see you in the morning, all right?"

85.speaker: Vina Toras
85.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Vina"] < 0) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_Approve"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_ApproveAfterPales"] == true) == false)

86.speaker: Narrator
86.text: Before I could respond, the line dropped.

87.speaker: Narrator
87.text: I put down the receiver and sat on the bed, my head still abuzz with the news.

100.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
100.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false

101.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
101.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false

102.speaker: Narrator
102.text: I was in bed next to Lucita when the private phone in my living quarters rang.
102.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false

108.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
108.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false

109.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
109.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false

110.speaker: Lucita Azaro
110.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false

111.speaker: Narrator
111.text: My wife's voice sounded like it was coming from miles away.

115.speaker: Pabel Adria
115.text: "I heard a noise. Is everything all right, {RiziaDLCText.PabelToPlayer}?"

116.speaker: Narrator
116.text: My lover's voice sounded like it was coming from miles away.

117.speaker: Narrator
117.text: Just then, Pabel rushed into my quarters.
117.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Lord"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_RelationshipPublic"] == true) == false)

118.speaker: Narrator
118.text: My butler's voice sounded like it was coming from miles away.

123.speaker: Vina Toras
123.text: "Now that this ordeal is behind us, do Manus and I finally have your permission to marry?"

127.speaker: Player_Romus
127.text: "Manus is still fighting, sweetheart. We'll have this conversation if he returns."

131.speaker: Player_Romus
131.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true)

132.speaker: Narrator
132.text: A tremor appeared in her voice.

134.speaker: Player_Romus
134.text: "Yes, of course. If anyone deserves to be happy, it's you two."
134.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true) == false)

137.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
137.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_RelationshipPublic"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false

138.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
138.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_RelationshipPublic"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false

139.speaker: Player_Romus
139.text: "Sure, why not? I'm a married man myself these days."
139.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_RelationshipPublic"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false)

141.speaker: Vina Toras
141.text: "I know. I heard the guards gossiping."

143.speaker: Player_Romus
143.text: "I'm afraid much has changed in Rizia since you were taken hostage. Pairing you off with Manus is no longer a possibility."

144.speaker: Narrator
144.text: A tremor appeared in her voice.

146.speaker: Narrator
146.text: She gave a barely contained shriek of joy.

147.speaker: Vina Toras
147.text: "Oh, I can't wait to be home! Thank you!"

150.speaker: Vina Toras
150.text: "We really do have to go. But this conversation is not over."

158.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
158.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Rescue_Success"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] == true)

160.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
160.text: "Your Majesty… I apologize for the late hour.”

164.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
164.text: "I was supervising our troops near the border when I got word that Princess Vina and her rescuers had arrived from the front lines."

165.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
165.text: "And I am here with someone who's been eager to speak with you for months."

171.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
171.text: "Your Majesty… I apologize for the late hour.”

175.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
175.text: "I suggest sitting down if you're not already.

176.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
176.text: "What I have to share won’t be easy to hear."

181.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
181.text: "I just received news from the frontline..."

186.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
186.text: "I regret to report, Your Majesty, that Princess Vina did not survive her captivity in Pales."

187.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
187.text: "I am sorry, Your Majesty. I never--"

193.speaker: Player_Romus
193.text: "It's not my decision anymore. You'll have to ask Prime Minister Sazon."
193.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_PrimeMinister_Manus"] == true)

195.speaker: Narrator
195.text: She gave a barely contained shriek of joy.

196.speaker: Vina Toras
196.text: "This is incredible! I can't wait to get home."

197.speaker: Player_Romus
197.text: "You don't have to ask me, Vina. You're free to do whatever you want."
197.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_PrimeMinister_Manus"] == true) == false)

204.text: I was in bed next to Pabel when the private phone in my living quarters rang.
